page.overview:
Who is Iris?

Iris (アイリス Iris), also known by her title as The Girl Who Knows the Hearts of Dragons, is the Gym Leader of Opelucid City's Gym in the Unova region in the Pokémon White Version only, as the eighth and last. Iris lives in Opelucid City, and specializes in using -type Pokémon. She will award the player the Legend Badge if the player defeats her. In Black, Draydon takes her place. In the two-year gap between Pokémon Black Version and Pokémon White Version and Pokémon Black Version 2 and Pokémon White Version 2, she has become the Unova League's Pokémon Champion after Alder, whom she defeated after intense training.

Iris is a young, thin girl. She is dark-skinned with a medium brown complexion, red-brown eyes, and very long and dark purple hair tied back with yellow bangles in thick ponytails that resemble the petals of an iris blossom, hence her name.

Iris wears a light-pink-colored long-sleeved dress with purple cuffs. Slightly like in Pokemon Black and White, she has white leggings with pink colored ends at the legs, and pink in white-strapped shoes with no socks. Her hair is possibly tied up in a small bun with small wing-like spike design.

Iris wears a cream-colored long-sleeved top with a pink collar and cuffs, a pink puffy miniskirt with a slit on the left side ,and a big ribbon over it. She also has white leggings with yellow colored ends at the legs, and pink and white yellow-strapped shoes with no socks.
